title: The Subtle Art of Not Giving a F*ck
author: Mark Manson
description: A counterintuitive self-help argument: caring about fewer things, and choosing them well, is the path to a better life.

title: Scrum: The Art of Doing Twice the Work in Half the Time
author: Jeff Sutherland, J.J. Sutherland
description: The co-creator of Scrum on how small, focused, self-organising teams get dramatically more done.

title: Startup
author: Eleonora Chioda, Giancarlo Donadio, Lucia Ingrosso, Tiziana Tripepi
description: A practical Italian handbook on turning an idea into a company, from validation to growth.

title: Let My People Go Surfing
author: Yvon Chouinard
description: Patagonia's founder on building a company around environmental and ethical principles — the education of a reluctant businessman.

title: Il piacere del vino
author: Paola Gho, Giovanni Ruffa
description: Slow Food's classic manual for learning to taste, understand and enjoy wine.

title: Clima. Come evitare un disastro
author: Bill Gates
description: Bill Gates lays out a concrete plan for reaching zero greenhouse-gas emissions and avoiding climate catastrophe.

title: La caffettiera del masochista
author: Donald A. Norman
description: The classic on human-centred design: why good design is invisible and bad design quietly drives us mad.

title: L'arte della vittoria
author: Phil Knight
description: Italian edition of 'Shoe Dog' — the Nike founder's candid memoir of building the company from the trunk of his car.

title: Clamoroso
author: Gianmarco Pozzecco, Filippo Venturi
description: The exuberant memoir of Gianmarco Pozzecco, one of Italian basketball's most beloved and unpredictable figures.

title: I sette peccati capitali dell'economia italiana
author: Carlo Cottarelli
description: Economist Carlo Cottarelli diagnoses the seven chronic flaws holding back the Italian economy.

title: Kobe Bryant. L'uomo che ha incantato il basket
author: La Gazzetta dello Sport
description: A tribute to Kobe Bryant — his career, his Mamba mentality and the mark he left on basketball.

title: Patagonia Express
author: Luis Sepúlveda
description: Luis Sepúlveda's travel tales across Patagonia — journalism and storytelling from the end of the world.

title: Autostop con Buddha
author: Will Ferguson
description: Will Ferguson hitchhikes the length of Japan chasing the cherry-blossom front — a wry, affectionate travelogue.

title: UX Writing. Micro testi, macro impatto
author: Serena Giust
description: A practical Italian guide to UX writing: how microcopy and emotion guide people through a product.

title: Manuale di sopravvivenza per UX Designer
author: Matteo di Pascale
description: A hands-on Italian field guide to UX design, from research to practical product work.

title: La nazione delle piante
author: Stefano Mancuso
description: Neurobiologist Stefano Mancuso imagines a constitution written by plants — a manifesto for a wiser way to live.

title: Storia di una balena bianca raccontata da lei stessa
author: Luis Sepúlveda
description: A fable narrated by a white whale, on memory, freedom and our bond with the sea.

title: Storia di una lumaca che scoprì l'importanza della lentezza
author: Luis Sepúlveda
description: A gentle fable about a snail who sets out to understand the value of slowness.

title: Il vecchio che leggeva romanzi d'amore
author: Luis Sepúlveda
description: In the Amazon, an old man who reads love stories is drawn into a hunt — a short, vivid eco-parable.

title: Questo è il marketing
author: Seth Godin
description: Seth Godin reframes marketing as empathy and service: earning trust by helping people become who they want to be.

title: Marketing Luther King
author: Simone Ciaruffoli
description: Simone Ciaruffoli on storytelling as the heart of marketing — your product is the story you can tell.

title: Il vicolo cieco
author: Seth Godin
description: Seth Godin's small book ('The Dip') on knowing when to quit and when to push through.

title: Ruba come un artista
author: Austin Kleon
description: Austin Kleon's illustrated manifesto on creativity: nothing is original, so steal like an artist.
